effects.Function: Rust/Weathering Effect (Enamel): Rust-colored liquid used to simulate rust streaks on metal vehicles, armor, or stone surfaces near metal objects Applied in thin lines and then softened with Enamel Thinner.
effects.Keywords: Rust, Enamel, Streaking, Weathering, Streaks

effects.Function: Concrete/Cement Texture: Thick acrylic-based product, ready for use, simulating the texture and color of concrete. Ideal for creating foundations, floors, or walls in your diorama base.
effects.Keywords: Concrete, Diorama, Texture, London, Base

effects.Function: Dark Steel Pigment (Powder): Ultrafine powder used to create dust and dirt effects, or to polish metal surfaces (like knight's chainmail), giving a realistic dark metallic shine. Applied dry or fixed with pigment fixer.
effects.Keywords: Pigment, Steel, Polishing, Chainmail, Realistic Metal

effects.Function: Green Moss Texture: Acrylic product that simulates moss and lichen on surfaces. Great for adding life and moisture to stones, contrasting with grey or reddish rock.
effects.Keywords: Moss, Moisture, Lichen, Texture

effects.Function: Satin Varnish (Acrylic): Varnish with an intermediate finish between matte and glossy. Ideal for providing a slight 'moisture' sheen or protecting colors that should not be completely matte.
effects.Keywords: Varnish, Satin, Protection, Slight Sheen, Acrylic

effects.Function: White Primer/Sealer (Acrylic): White base to prepare surfaces (plastic, resin, metal, stone). Essential to ensure paint adhesion and make bright colors more vibrant.
effects.Keywords: Primer, White, Adhesion, Vibrant Colors, Preparatory Base

effects.Function: Black Primer/Sealer (Acrylic): Black base color. Great for pre-shading and dark colors. Helps define recesses and gives immediate depth to the miniature.
effects.Keywords: Primer, Black, Pre-shading, Zenithal, Armor

effects.Function: Acrylic Thinner: Used to thin AK acrylic paints and primers, whether for airbrush application or to create smoother, more controlled washes with a brush.
effects.Keywords: Thinner, Diluent, Airbrush, Washes, Acrylic

effects.Function: Gravel & Sand Fixer (Liquid): Transparent adhesive/liquid used to fix sand, gravel, small stones, and flock on the diorama base, ensuring they don't come loose.
effects.Keywords: Fixer, Sand, Gravel, Diorama Glue, Base Building

effects.Function: NATO Camouflage Color: Standard brown used in modern NATO military vehicles. Ideal for military dioramas or simulating dry mud and packed earth on bases.
effects.Keywords: Dry Mud, Military, NATO, Camouflage, Earth

effects.Function: Extreme Snow Effect: White microsphere powder simulating fresh fallen snow. Can be mixed with resin or glossy varnish for melting snow.
effects.Keywords: Snow, Diorama, Winter, Texture, Microballoons

effects.Function: Fresh Blood Effect: Technical paint with a glossy and viscous finish that maintains a 'wet' look even after drying.
effects.Keywords: Blood, Gore, Realism, Gloss, Technical

effects.Function: Shade for Skin and Warm Tones: Reddish-brown shading paint that adds depth and warmth to skin tones, gold, bronze, and reds.
effects.Keywords: Shade, Wash, Skin, Gold, Bronze, Effect

effects.Function: This is the ideal choice if you want a "real steel" look or knightly armour. It creates deep shadows and dramatically defines the volumes of the piece. With Sterling Silver, it remains bright on the highlights, but the recesses become very dark, simulating heavy, oily metal.
effects.Keywords: Armour, Real steel, Weapons, Mechanical parts, etc.

effects.Function: Widely used for metals that should appear extremely polished, new, or with a touch of energy to create a bluish metal effect or a magical/icy appearance. The blue contrasts softly with the silver, providing a cold and clean look. Excellent for sci-fi weapons or armour for heroic characters.
effects.Keywords: Enchanted armour, Magic, Enchanted steel, Enchanted weapons, Polished parts, etc.

effects.Function: If your goal is for the silver to look ancient, dirty, or slightly rusted. It adds an organic brownish/yellowish tone that simulates accumulated grime. Perfect for fantasy pieces that have been through battles or are exposed to the elements.
effects.Keywords: Ancient metal, Aged bronze, Industrial machinery, etc.

effects.Function: Provides intense gloss and extreme protection with polyurethane resin. It is flexible, resistant to UV rays and impacts, making it ideal for handled pieces. Can be applied with a brush or airbrush, with the recommendation to respect a 4-hour interval between layers for perfect curing.
effects.Keywords: Varnish, Gloss, Extreme protection, Acrylic

effects.Function: Polyvinyl acetate adhesive used as a versatile foundation for terrain building. Ideal for creating DIY snow pastes when mixed with baking soda, generating subtle cracking/iced ground effects when applied over a painted base, and securely bonding raw landscape assets like sand, gravel, or foam.
effects.Keywords: Glue, PVA, White Glue, Adhesive, DIY, Snow Recipe, Crackle

effects.Function: Fine chemical powder used in hobby modeling to simulate realistic weather effects. When mixed with PVA glue and water, it creates a budget-friendly, high-volume paste that perfectly replicates the texture and accumulation of fresh, crisp snow.
effects.Keywords: Baking Soda, Bicarbonate, Snow Recipe, DIY, Texture, Powder

effects.Function: A strong, fast-acting adhesive used for quick bonding of small parts and details in miniature assembly. Ideal for attaching delicate pieces or creating instant bonds between materials like plastic, metal, or resin.
effects.Keywords: Cianoacrylate, Super Glue, Adhesive, Bonding, DIY

effects.Function: A high-quality black primer designed for use on various surfaces, providing an excellent base for subsequent painting layers.
effects.Keywords: Primer, Black, Base Coat, Painting

effects.Function: Metallic paint created from a wax base. Made from high quality pigments, achieving extremely realistic effects. Specially designed for modelers, these waxes can be applied by brush, with the fingertip, with a cotton swab or ever with airbrush diluted with our Thinner (white spirit) and getting a fine surface. Once dried, it can be polished to achieve a metallic finish. Recommended to prime first and can be varnish with acrylic too. This is a wax base so It is recommended allow 48h to be completely dry.
effects.Keywords: Silver, Painting, Metallic, Wax Base, Realistic

effects.Function: Metallic paint created from a wax base. Made from high quality pigments, achieving extremely realistic effects. Specially designed for modelers, these waxes can be applied by brush, with the fingertip, with a cotton swab or ever with airbrush diluted with our Thinner (white spirit) and getting a fine surface. Once dried, it can be polished to achieve a metallic finish. Recommended to prime first and can be varnish with acrylic too. This is a wax base so It is recommended allow 48h to be completely dry.
effects.Keywords: Gold, Painting, Metallic, Wax Base, Realistic

effects.Function: Highly pigmented special gold paint, which can present a realistic gold finish on almost all smooth surfaces (such as plastic, glass, wood and rubber). The special precision tip is perfect for detailing all types of figures and parts in any scale. The formulation allows for subsequent antiquing treatments.
effects.Keywords: Gold, Painting, Pen, Metallic, Realistic, Detailing

effects.Function: Puddles is a slightly tinted especially liquid crystalline product designed to replicate small puddles and standing dirty water on your dioramas and vignettes.
effects.Keywords: Puddles, Water, Dirty, Diorama, Vignette

effects.Function: UHU Universal Glue is a versatile, high-strength adhesive suitable for a wide range of materials including plastic, metal, wood, and fabric.
effects.Keywords: UHU, Universal Glue, Adhesive, Bonding, DIY
